MODE 2-1: 1-VAR

Single-variable stats including n, mean, σx/sx, min/max, Q1, median, Q3.

keys
MODE→2→1

Use for lists, test scores, and any one-column frequency analysis. Enable FREQ in SET UP when values repeat.

formula
univariate summaries
steps

Open this type

  1. MODE→2→1
  2. Clear or edit data in the Statistics Editor as needed
  3. AC, then SHIFT 1 (STAT) for Var / MinMax recalls
